title: 第5章 苟到了签到点第6章 签到完成准备送死
slug: 系统绑错人龙套被迫走主角剧本
content_zh:
龙涛将早已准备好的驱兽粉取出，按照卖他货那位师兄的说法，这驱兽粉虽有些问题，但对付小型妖兽还是绰绰有余的。
不过他并没有急着在空地处使用，这里瘴气较浓，驱兽粉的效果会被大大降低，甚至可能会让几只蝎子快速适应，用前世的话说，也就是过早产生耐药性。
拼了命冲过这片开阔地后，龙涛进入另一端的密林，这里的瘴气明显比之前的林子要浓些，短时间还好，如果一晚上都耗在这的花，麻烦可就大了。
当然...身后那三只蝎子也准时跟了过来，龙涛这次没再犹豫，抓住一把驱兽粉就转身丢了过去。
漫天红雾在无风的密林中炸开，驱兽粉的辛辣瞬间盖过腐臭。
三只蝎子如遭雷击，节肢在苔藓上刮出刺耳声响，竟互相推挤着退出林地边缘，在月光下的空地焦躁徘徊。
“哈...哈...”
龙涛背靠树干急喘，冷汗浸透的衣袍紧贴后背。
轻身术的灵力如潮水退去，双腿突然一软，膝盖重重磕在树根上。
他再次体会到自己有多弱鸡，轻身术这种术法，放前世的那些小说里，别说修仙世界了，在武侠世界里都算不上高深，却能让现在的自己被暂时榨干脚力。
抬头看了看月亮的位置，确定离子时还有不少时间，因此也不急着赶路，找了个树爬上去开始休息。
在第五次把那两只拳头大小的蜘蛛从披风上赶下去后，他的双腿总算恢复了不少，虽然很难用出第二次的轻身术，但正常跑跳已经没问题了。
就在他准备跟着系统指示继续前行时，一声巨大的吼叫响彻了整座山崖。
这声波攻击效果拔群！
刚才还在开演唱会的虫群集体静音三秒，紧接着就跟过年放鞭炮似的乱窜。
树底下更热闹了，之前没见到的野猪刺猬甚至癞蛤蟆都一只只地窜了出来。
不用多想，这声吼叫多半就是系统说的那只筑基三层的妖兽，听声音应该是只狼，而且好巧不巧，声音来源的方向正好就是系统箭头指引的方向，果然...这任务压根就没打算让自己活着回去。
况且别说远处，周围此时也出现了十多只大小不一的野兽，大猫大狗大老鼠大猪一应俱全，加上地面上数不清的虫子，让人有种想要放个aoe技能全A掉的冲动。
但是很遗憾，练气五层没什么杀伤性强的范围技能，真用出来也就当个刮痧师傅。
但眼前的境况已经完全失控了，如果贸然下去，自己这个突然出现的异类，很可能会被兽群给当作敌人围攻。

他又回想起刚才的那声狼嚎，虽然听着很恐怖，但到底也只是一只筑基三层的小boss，距离应该不会太远，如果再冲一次的话...是有机会一口气冲过去的。
又低头看了眼树下那些狂躁不安的野兽，龙涛再次下定了决心，把白天刚买的那瓶回气丹取出吃了一颗。
“嗯？”
龙涛按照以前的经验，吞下去后开始运气，却发现没什么效果，又吃了一颗...还是没什么感觉，但又好像有那么点感觉，于是干脆一口气把一瓶里的六颗全都吞了下去，终于感到灵气和经脉的运行开始恢复。
“靠！
便宜果然没好货，骗我说什么只含一点杂质，效果有正常的一半，这尼玛的...吃了六颗才和正常一颗差不多效果，老子亏麻了！”
龙涛心里发誓，这次如果活着回去，绝对不会再去买什么内门弟子炼丹的残次品了，吃个回气丹...气没回上来，肚子快先吃饱了！
但这会儿也轮不到他选了，龙涛又掏出白天一起购买的那三张轻身符，剩余的灵气需要等会儿更关键的时候保命，他打算将这些不稳定的劣等货先用掉算了。
抽出其中一张劣质轻身符，黄纸上的符文歪歪扭扭，关键节点处的朱砂还糊成了一团，估计是某个大家族的败家子弟直接用真材实料练习的成果，普通人肯定都是把笔画练熟了后，才会在珍贵的符纸上画符的，狗日的有钱人。
“算了，赌一把！”
content_en:
Long Tao took out the beast-repelling powder that he had prepared. According to the senior brother who sold him the product, although there were some problems with the beast-repelling powder, it was more than enough to deal with small monsters.
However, he was not in a hurry to use it in the open space. The miasma here was thicker and the effect of the repellent powder would be greatly reduced. It might even cause a few scorpions to adapt quickly. In the words of the previous life, it would lead to premature drug resistance.
After rushing through the open space with all his strength, Long Tao entered the dense forest at the other end. The miasma here was obviously thicker than the previous forest. It was okay for a short time. If he spent all the flowers here all night, he would be in big trouble.
Of course...the three scorpions behind him also came over on time. Long Tao didn't hesitate this time, grabbed a handful of animal repelling powder and turned around and threw it away.
The sky filled with red mist exploded in the windless dense forest, and the pungency of the animal repellent powder instantly overwhelmed the rancid smell.
As if struck by lightning, the three scorpions scraped their limbs on the moss with a screeching sound. They actually pushed each other and exited the edge of the forest, wandering anxiously in the clearing under the moonlight.
"Ha...ha..."
Long Tao leaned against a tree trunk and gasped, his clothes soaked in cold sweat clinging to his back.
The spiritual power of the Light Body Technique receded like a tide, and his legs suddenly became weak, and his knees hit the roots of the tree heavily.
He once again realized how weak he was. The technique of lightening one's body was not considered advanced in the novels of his previous life, let alone the world of cultivating immortals. It was not considered advanced in the world of martial arts, but it could temporarily drain him of his strength.
I looked up at the position of the moon and saw that there was still a lot of time to determine the ions, so I was not in a hurry and found a tree to climb up and start resting.
After driving the two fist-sized spiders off his cloak for the fifth time, his legs finally recovered a lot. Although it was difficult to use the second lightening technique, he could run and jump normally without any problem.
Just when he was about to follow the system instructions and continue moving forward, a huge roar resounded throughout the cliff.
The effect of this sonic attack is outstanding!
The insect swarm that was holding a concert just now was silent for three seconds, and then started running around like setting off firecrackers during the New Year.
It was even more lively under the tree, and wild boars, hedgehogs and even toads that had not been seen before came out one by one.
No need to think too much, this roar is probably the monster beast on the third level of the foundation mentioned by the system. The sound should be that of a wolf, and by coincidence, the direction of the sound source is exactly the direction pointed by the system arrow. Sure enough... This mission has no intention of letting me return alive.
Not to mention the distance, there were more than a dozen wild beasts of different sizes appearing around, including big cats, dogs, rats, and pigs. Coupled with the countless bugs on the ground, people had the urge to use all AOE skills.
But unfortunately, at the fifth level of Qi training, there are no lethal range skills. If you really use it, you can just be a scraping master.
But the situation in front of him was completely out of control. If he continued rashly, he, a sudden alien, would probably be besieged by the beasts as an enemy.
He recalled the wolf howl just now. Although it sounded terrifying, in the end it was just a small boss on the third floor of the foundation. It shouldn't be too far away. If he charged again... he would have a chance to rush over in one go.
Looking down at the restless wild beasts under the tree, Long Tao once again made up his mind and took out the bottle of Qi-Reviving Pill he just bought during the day and ate one.
"Huh?"
According to his previous experience, Long Tao started to get lucky after swallowing it, but found that it had no effect, so he took another pill... He still felt nothing, but he seemed to feel a little bit, so he simply swallowed all six pills in the bottle in one go, and finally felt that the movement of spiritual energy and meridians began to recover.
"Fuck!
Sure enough, it’s cheap but not good. You lied to me and said that it only contains a little impurity and the effect is half of the normal one. Damn it... I took six pills to have about the same effect as the normal one. I’m so sorry! "
Long Tao swore in his heart that this timeIf I go back alive, I will never buy any defective products from inner disciples' alchemy. I will take a Qi-rejuvenating pill... Before I can regain my Qi, my stomach is almost full!
But it was not his turn to choose now. Long Tao took out the three light body charms he bought together during the day. The remaining spiritual energy would need to wait for a more critical moment to save his life. He planned to use these unstable and inferior goods first.
Pulling out one of the low-quality light body charms, the runes on the yellow paper were crooked, and the cinnabar at the key nodes was mushy. It was probably the result of direct practice by a prodigal son of a big family using real materials. Ordinary people must have mastered the strokes before they would draw the charms on the precious talisman paper. Rich people like this.
"Forget it, let's take a gamble!"
